subject: How to calculate step cadence in GGIR

messages.author: 98fb57d9ed19af69
messages.subject: How to calculate step cadence in GGIR
parts:
Dear Matthew

Thank you so much for your work and for your step counter.

Our group wants to analyze the association of step counts and step cadence with different health outcomes.  However, we failed to get step cadence from your algorithm.

We also found a paper published by Dr. Alex V. Rowlands in 2022, which mentioned that "Details of the original and revised algorithm parameters are in the supplemental methods.". However, we did not find the supplemental methods.

So, we would appreciate it if you could guide us on what parameters need to be modified to calculate step cadence in GGIR!!!

Thank you in advance for your help!

Best regards,

Puchen Zhou

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: How to calculate step cadence in GGIR
parts:
Hi Puchen,

This algorithm currently only gives you the step count. You can derive the step cadence yourself by going into the individual participant epoch files (epochvalues2csv = TRUE), and deriving cadence based on the number of steps achieved per epoch. 

Hope that helps,
Ben
